## Set up and Data Extraction
```{r}
setwd(INPUT PATH HERE)
library(fields)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(paletteer)
library(ggplot2)
library(PNWColors)
```


```{r}
# list names of all columns to pull from data
cols_to_pull <- c("Influenza.excld..avian.influenza.and.pandemic.influenza.",
                  "Respiratory.syncytial.virus.infection",
                  "Pharyngoconjunctival.fever",
                  "Group.A.streptococcal.pharyngitis",
                  "Infectious.gastroenteritis",
                  "Hand..foot.and.mouth.disease",
                  "Erythema.infection",
                  "Exanthem.subitum",
                  "Herpangina",
                  "Acute.hemorrhagic.conjunctivitis",
                  "Epidemic.keratoconjunctivitis",
                  "Bacterial.meningitis",
                  "Aseptic.meningitis",
                  "Mycoplasma.pneumonia",
                  "Chlamydial.pneumonia.excluding.psittacosis.")

all_cols <- c("Influenza.cases","RSV.cases","PCF.cases",
          "AStrep.cases","Gastro.cases",
          "HFMD.cases",
          "Erythema.cases","Exanthem.cases","Herpangina.cases",
          "hemo.conj.cases","keratoconj.cases","bact.meningitis.cases",
          "Aseptic.meningitis.cases","Mpneumoniae.cases",
          "Chlamydial.pneumonia.cases"
          )

# name columns and 'names' of specific disease wanted for analysis
cols <- c("Erythema.cases","Influenza.cases","RSV.cases","Mpneumoniae.cases",
          "PCF.cases","Herpangina.cases")
names <- c("Erythema","Influenza", "RSV","M. pneumoniae",
           "Pharyngoconj. fever","Herpangina")

# pull data from file folders
year_folds <- list.files("Japan_surveillance_2015_2023")
full.data <- data.frame()
for (i in 1:length(cols)){
full.data[[cols[i]]]  <- numeric()
}
full.data$year <- integer()
full.data$week.of.year <- integer()
for (i in 1:(length(year_folds)-1)){
  current_fold <- year_folds[i]
  week_files <- list.files(paste0("Japan_surveillance_2015_2023/",
                                  current_fold))
  for (j in 1:52){
    sub <- read.csv(paste0("Japan_surveillance_2015_2023/",
                           current_fold,"/",week_files[j]),skip = 3)
    sub <- sub[, !grepl("X", colnames(sub))]
    sub <- sub[2,]
    sub <- sub[, colnames(sub) %in% cols_to_pull]
    sub <- sub[,cols_to_pull]
    colnames(sub) <- all_cols
    sub$year <- current_fold
    sub$week.of.year <- j
    full.data <- rbind(full.data,sub)
    }
}

# replace all empty values with 0
full.data[full.data == "-"] <- 0

# ensure numeric values
for(disease in all_cols){
  full.data[[disease]] <- as.numeric(full.data[[disease]])
}


# set color scale for figures later on
colors <-c(pnw_palette("Starfish", 12)[c(1,3,6,9,11)],"#F4AA78")
barplot(rep(1,length.out = length(colors)),col = colors)
```


## Incidence data time series plots
```{r}
# set color scales
reds <- colorRampPalette(c("#341539", "#D8AAE0"))(5)
greys <- colorRampPalette(c("#5c5c5c","lightgrey"))(5)

# remove 2014 due to missing data
tot.data <- full.data[full.data$year != 2014,]

# set storage path
path <- "figures/fig1/"

# make plots
for (nname in 1:length(cols)){
  
  # call current disease and name
  curcol <- cols[nname]
  name <- names[nname]
  i = 1
  png(paste0(path,curcol,".png"),width =3.1, height = 3,
      units = 'in',res =300)
  # plot each year of cases
  for (year in unique(tot.data$year)){
    sub <- tot.data[tot.data$year == year,]
    if (year == 2015){
      par(mar = c(2, 2, 3, 0.5))
      plot(sub$week.of.year,sub[[curcol]], 
           type = 'l',ylim = c(0,max(tot.data[[curcol]]*1.1)), col = greys[i],lwd = 2.5,
           xlab = "",ylab = "",main = name, bty = "l")
    } else if (year <2020) {
      i <- i+1
      lines(sub$week.of.year,sub[[curcol]], col = greys[i],lwd = 2.5)
    } else {
      i <- i+1
      lines(sub$week.of.year,sub[[curcol]], col = reds[i-5],lwd = 2.5)
    }
  }
  dev.off()
}

# make a color bar for label 
full_colors <- c(greys, reds)
png(paste0(path,"caselegend.png"), width =4, height = 2,
    units = 'in',res =300)
par(mar = c(0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5))
plot.new()
image.plot(legend.only = TRUE, col = full_colors, zlim =c(2015,2024),
           legend.lab = "",legend.line = 2,
           smallplot   = c(0.1, 0.9,0.5, 0.55),
           horizontal = T)
dev.off()

```


```{r}
# make data frame version of cumulative cases of above data
sum_cases <-data.frame("week" = 0:520)

# compute running cumulative cases and store cases at each step
for(j in 1:length(all_cols)){
  sum_cases[[paste0(all_cols[j],".sum")]] <- 0
  sum_cases[[paste0(all_cols[j],".act")]] <- 0
  i = 2
  for (year in 2015:2024){
    sub = tot.data[tot.data$year == year,]
    for (week in 1:52){
      new_cases <- sub[[all_cols[j]]][week]
      sum_cases[[paste0(all_cols[j],".sum")]][i] <- new_cases +
        sum_cases[[paste0(all_cols[j],".sum")]][i-1]
      sum_cases[[paste0(all_cols[j],".act")]][i] <- new_cases
      i = i +1
    }
  }
}

png("figures/fig1/CumulativeCases.png", width =8, height = 5.6,
    units = 'in',res =300)
par(mar = c(2,2,0.5,0.5))

# set time to take norm of cases
year_of_norm = 5 

# plot cumulative cases for each disease
for(i in 1:(length(cols))){
  tseries <- sum_cases[[paste0(cols[i],".sum")]]
  tseries <- tseries/tseries[52*year_of_norm+11]
  if(i == 1){
    plot(tseries,type = 'l', lwd = 3.5,
     ylim = c(0,2),
     ylab = "Norm. Cummulative Cases", xlab = "Weeks", col = colors[i], bty = 'l')
  }else{
    lines(tseries, lwd = 3.5, col = colors[i])
  }
}
# add vertical line at time of normalization
abline(v = 52*year_of_norm, lwd = 2, lty = 2, col = "grey")
legend("topleft",legend = c(names, 2020),col = c(colors,"grey"), 
       lwd = c(8,8,8,8,8,8,4),lty = c(1,1,1,1,1,1,2))
dev.off()
```

## Computation of counterfactual predictions
```{r}
# Set number of Fourier terms to include in statistical counterfactual
num_terms <- 10
for (term in c(0.5,1:num_terms)) {
  sum_cases[[paste0("cos", term)]] <- cos( 2*pi * term * sum_cases$week / 52)
  sum_cases[[paste0("sin", term)]] <- sin( 2*pi * term * sum_cases$week / 52)
}

# make formula in terms of terms above
fourier_terms <- paste(
  c(paste0("cos", c(0.5,1:num_terms)), paste0("sin", c(0.5,1:num_terms))),
  collapse = " + "
)

# set training data to be precovid
dat.precovid <-sum_cases[sum_cases$week < (52*year_of_norm+11),]

# fit regression model to Fourier forumulation from above for each disease
fits <- list()
for(disease in all_cols){
  eqn <- paste0("log(",disease, ".act + 1) ~ ", fourier_terms)
  fits[[disease]] <- lm(eqn, data = dat.precovid)

  # predict the counter factual
  log_cases <- predict(fits[[disease]], newdata = sum_cases)
  sum_cases[[paste0(disease,".counter")]] <- exp(log_cases)-1
}


```

## Compution of burden metrics
```{r}
for(disease in all_cols){
  # ensure counterfactual on the training period is exactly the true data
  sum_cases[[paste0(disease,".counter")]][sum_cases$week <(52*5+11)] <-
    sum_cases[[paste0(disease,".act")]][sum_cases$week <(52*5+11)]
  
  # initialize metrics
  sum_cases[[paste0(disease,".short_monthly")]] <- 0
  sum_cases[[paste0(disease,".short_3month")]] <- 0
  sum_cases[[paste0(disease,".long")]] <- 0

  
  # compute metrics
  denom_window_len <- 51
  for(i in (denom_window_len+1):nrow(sum_cases)){
    # monthly metric
    num_len <- 4
      num_window <- (i-num_len):(i)
      denom_window <- (i-denom_window_len):(i)
      numerator <- sum(sum_cases[[paste0(disease,".act")]][num_window]-
                         sum_cases[[paste0(disease,".counter")]][num_window])
      denominator <- max(sum_cases[[paste0(disease,".counter")]][denom_window])
      sum_cases[[paste0(disease,".short_monthly")]][i] <- numerator/denominator
      
      # three month metric
      num_len <- 12
      num_window <- (i-num_len):(i)
      numerator <- sum(sum_cases[[paste0(disease,".act")]][num_window]-
                         sum_cases[[paste0(disease,".counter")]][num_window])
      sum_cases[[paste0(disease,".short_3month")]][i] <- numerator/denominator
    
      # long term metric
      numerator <- sum(sum_cases[[paste0(disease,".act")]][1:i]-
                         sum_cases[[paste0(disease,".counter")]][1:i])
      sum_cases[[paste0(disease,".long")]][i] <- numerator/
        max(sum_cases[[paste0(disease,".counter")]])
    
  }
}

# set all na values to 0
for(i in 1:ncol(sum_cases)){
  sum_cases[is.nan(sum_cases[,i]),i] <- 0
}

```

## Data plots of simple metrics
```{r}
# reshape data and store max and total cases for each disease and year
i <- 1
for (disease in all_cols){
  for (year in unique(tot.data$year)){
    sub <- tot.data[[disease]][tot.data$year == year]
    annual_tot_cases <- sum(sub)
    annual_max_cases <- max(sub)
    if (i == 1){
      relplt.dat <- data.frame(disease = disease,
                               year = year,
                               annual_tot_cases = annual_tot_cases,
                               annual_max_cases = annual_max_cases)
      i = i+1
    } else{
      new.dat <- data.frame(disease = disease,
                               year = year,
                               annual_tot_cases = annual_tot_cases,
                               annual_max_cases = annual_max_cases)
      relplt.dat <- rbind(relplt.dat,new.dat)
    }
  }
}

# for each disease, compute mean and max cases
i <- 1
for (disease in all_cols){
  sub_pre <- relplt.dat[(relplt.dat$disease == disease) &
                          (relplt.dat$year <2020),]
  sub_post <- relplt.dat[(relplt.dat$disease == disease) &
                          (relplt.dat$year >=2020),]
  rel.meancases <- mean(sub_post$annual_tot_cases)/
    mean(sub_pre$annual_tot_cases)
  rel.maxtot <- max(sub_post$annual_tot_cases)/
    mean(sub_pre$annual_tot_cases)
  rel.maxpeak <- max(sub_post$annual_max_cases)/
    mean(sub_pre$annual_max_cases)
  if (i == 1){
    plt.dat <- data.frame(disease = disease,
                          rel.meancases= rel.meancases,
                          rel.maxtot=rel.maxtot,
                          rel.maxpeak= rel.maxpeak)
    i <- i+1
  } else{
    new.dat <- data.frame(disease = disease,
                          rel.meancases= rel.meancases,
                          rel.maxtot=rel.maxtot,
                          rel.maxpeak= rel.maxpeak)
    plt.dat <- rbind(plt.dat,new.dat)
  }
}

# make scatter plots of values
path <- "figures/fig1/"
png(paste0(path,"relmaxtot.png"),width =4.2, height = 4.2, units = 'in',res =300)
par(mar = c(2, 2, 0.5, 0.5))
plot(plt.dat$rel.meancases,plt.dat$rel.maxtot, bty = 'l', pch = 16, 
     xlab = "Rel. Mean Annual Cases", ylab = "Rel. Max Tot. Annual Cases",
     ylim = c(min(plt.dat$rel.maxtot),1.01*max(plt.dat$rel.maxtot)),
     xlim = c(min(plt.dat$rel.meancases)-0.07,1.16*max(plt.dat$rel.meancases)))
idx_tolabel <- match(cols,all_cols)
text(plt.dat$rel.meancases[idx_tolabel],
     plt.dat$rel.maxtot[idx_tolabel],
     labels = names,pos = 3,offset = 0.3)
dev.off()
png(paste0(path,"relmaxpeak.png"),width =4.2, height = 4.2, units = 'in',res =300)
par(mar = c(2, 2, 0.5, 0.5))
plot(plt.dat$rel.meancases,plt.dat$rel.maxpeak, bty = 'l', pch = 16, 
     xlab = "Rel. Mean Annual Cases", ylab = "Rel. Max Peak Cases",
     ylim = c(min(plt.dat$rel.maxpeak),1.1*max(plt.dat$rel.maxpeak)),
     xlim = c(min(plt.dat$rel.meancases)-0.1,1.2*max(plt.dat$rel.meancases)))
idx_tolabel <- match(cols,all_cols)
text(plt.dat$rel.meancases[idx_tolabel],
     plt.dat$rel.maxpeak[idx_tolabel],
     labels = names,pos = 3)
dev.off()
```

```{r}

# compute error bars for all diseases
i<- 1
for (disease in cols){
  sub_pre <- relplt.dat[(relplt.dat$disease == disease) &
                          (relplt.dat$year <2020),]
  sub_post <- relplt.dat[(relplt.dat$disease == disease) &
                          (relplt.dat$year >=2020),]
  premax.mean <- mean(sub_pre$annual_max_cases)
  pretot.mean <- mean(sub_pre$annual_tot_cases)
  sub_pre$annual_max_cases <- sub_pre$annual_max_cases/premax.mean
  sub_pre$annual_tot_cases <- sub_pre$annual_tot_cases/pretot.mean
  sub_post$annual_max_cases <- sub_post$annual_max_cases/premax.mean
  sub_post$annual_tot_cases <- sub_post$annual_tot_cases/pretot.mean
  premax.mean <- mean(sub_pre$annual_max_cases)
  pretot.mean <- mean(sub_pre$annual_tot_cases)
  premax.lb <- premax.mean-1.96*sd(sub_pre$annual_max_cases)
  premax.ub <- premax.mean+1.96*sd(sub_pre$annual_max_cases)
  pretot.lb <- pretot.mean - 1.96*sd(sub_pre$annual_tot_cases)
  pretot.ub <- pretot.mean + 1.96*sd(sub_pre$annual_tot_cases)
  
  postmax.max <- max(sub_post$annual_max_cases)
  posttot.max <- max(sub_post$annual_tot_cases)
  
  relmean <- mean(sub_post$annual_tot_cases)/mean(sub_pre$annual_tot_cases)
  
  if(i == 1){
    lineplt.dat <- data.frame(name = names[i],
                              disease = disease,
                              premax.mean = premax.mean,
                              pretot.mean = pretot.mean,
                              premax.lb = premax.lb,
                              premax.ub = premax.ub,
                              pretot.lb = pretot.lb,
                              pretot.ub = pretot.ub,
                              postmax.max = postmax.max,
                              posttot.max = posttot.max,
                              relmean = relmean)
    
  } else{
    newdata <- data.frame(name = names[i],
                          disease = disease,
                          premax.mean = premax.mean,
                              pretot.mean = pretot.mean,
                              premax.lb = premax.lb,
                              premax.ub = premax.ub,
                              pretot.lb = pretot.lb,
                              pretot.ub = pretot.ub,
                              postmax.max = postmax.max,
                              posttot.max = posttot.max,
                          relmean = relmean)
    lineplt.dat <- rbind(lineplt.dat,newdata)
  }
  i = i+1
}

# make line plots
plot1 <- ggplot(lineplt.dat, aes(x = premax.mean, y = reorder(name, postmax.max))) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_point(aes(x = postmax.max), size = 4, shape = 18, color = "#8E399C") +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = premax.lb, xmax = premax.ub),
                 height = 0.2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = 
               'grey') +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Rel. Annual Max Cases", y = "")
figscale <- 0.8
ggsave("figures/fig1/maxlineplt.png", plot = plot1, width = 4.5*figscale, height = 3*figscale, dpi  =300)

plot2 <- ggplot(lineplt.dat, aes(x = pretot.mean, y = reorder(name, postmax.max))) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_point(aes(x = relmean), size = 4, shape = 18, color = '#8E399C') +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = pretot.lb, xmax = pretot.ub),
                 height = 0.2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = 
               'grey') +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Rel. Annual Total Cases", y = "")+
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(),axis.ticks.y = element_blank())

ggsave("figures/fig1/totlineplt.png", plot = plot2, width = 3.5*figscale, height = 3*figscale, dpi  =300)

```

```{r}
     xlab = '',ylab = '', ylim = c(1.1*min(plt.dat$long),1.2*max(plt.dat$long)),
     xlim = c(0,1.2*max(plt.dat$rel.meancases)))

     plt.dat$long[idx_tolabel],
```
